tests.name: Within-snapshot incremental-information test
tests.comparison: Compare two nested logistic specifications on the discovery set stratified by snapshot: (A) baseline = up_day_ratio_20 + mom_20 + px_vs_ma50 + ma10_slope_5; (B) baseline + ibd_entry_close_position + ibd_entry_volume_ratio + ibd_entry_close_position*ibd_entry_volume_ratio. Compute likelihood-ratio chi-square and per-snapshot sign concordance of the interaction term across >=2 non-discovery snapshots in the validation window.
tests.success_criterion: Interaction term is positive in >=3 of 4 within-snapshot fits AND LR test p<0.05 AND AUC uplift >=0.03 over baseline.
tests.failure_criterion: Interaction term flips sign across folds OR LR test p>=0.10 OR AUC uplift <0.01, indicating the gate is a recoded proxy.

tests.name: Leave-one-snapshot-out threshold stability
tests.comparison: For each snapshot in {snap_71486ed83c, snap_d0d57b1e40, others}, fit a grid of (volume_ratio, close_position) thresholds on the remaining snapshots and compute optimal W4 ruin-rate separation on the held-out snapshot. Compare optimal volume floor distribution and close_position cut distribution across folds.
tests.success_criterion: Optimal volume floor lies in [1.4, 1.8] and optimal close_position cut lies in [0.82, 0.88] in >=3 of 4 folds (stability band).
tests.failure_criterion: Optimal thresholds span >0.4 in either dimension across folds, or collapse to a single-feature rule, indicating the proposed 1.3/1.7/0.80/0.85 cells are discovery-set artefacts.

leakage_checks: Verify ibd_entry_close_position and ibd_entry_volume_ratio are computed using only data available at the IBD entry decision timestamp (no peeking at post-entry close or post-entry volume prints).
Confirm that the proposed gate is applied as a hard post-B0 filter on the eligible B0 set only — no implicit universe expansion via relaxed B0 criteria.
Audit that snapshot id is not used as a feature in either test and that fold assignment is on snapshot identity alone, not on outcome label.
